neighbours.label: ' example' in mid-sentence ', for example,' that introduces a list of instances, as against other ways of introducing instances and other uses of 'example'
fire: Some birds, for example, robins and sparrows, stay all winter.
Many metals, for example, copper and silver, conduct heat well.
Certain jobs, for example, nursing and teaching, are hard to automate.
Several planets, for example, Jupiter and Saturn, have many moons.
Some vegetables, for example, carrots and beets, store well in sand.
A few languages, for example, Finnish and Hungarian, have no gender.
Many sports, for example, rugby and hockey, cause frequent injuries.
Some fabrics, for example, wool and silk, need gentle washing.
quiet: Some birds such as robins and sparrows stay all winter.
Many metals like copper and silver conduct heat well.
Certain jobs, including nursing and teaching, are hard to automate.
Several planets, among them Jupiter and Saturn, have many moons.
Some vegetables store well in sand, carrots and beets in particular.
Finnish is one example of a language with no gender.
Many sports cause injuries; rugby and hockey are the worst.
Some fabrics need gentle washing, wool and silk especially.
